assistant: ghtmost |

Larger = further left, measured from the right edge. So writing `hiddenbar_panel = <arrow position − 24>` before creating the item lands it one slot to the **right** of the arrow — permanently outside the collapse zone. Seed only when the key is absent, so a later ⌘-drag of yours wins forever after.

`scripts/menubar-probe.swift` verifies it after the build (it already prints `Hiddenbar Mirror (1) x=1040 visible` for the arrow). If AppKit turns out to ignore a pre-seeded key, the fallback is a one-time ⌘-drag — recoverable, since the icon would still exist.
